about_heading: Taught by a dentist who still treats patients
about_body:
Dr. Sandra Garcia Martin runs a cosmetic practice in London and teaches alongside it. Veneer School is where that clinical work is broken down for other dentists.

The course runs with tiered pricing and reduced student places, so it stays reachable whether you are newly qualified or already restoring cases every week.
